**Severity:** warning · **Area:** Config / plugin options (`RV7xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
Editor manifest stale ({reason} changed after it was written). Run `rivet sync`.
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Run `rivet sync` to refresh .rivet/editor.json.

## When it is reported

rivet-check only; warning.
